theorems.name: Submission.tdo_ods_ae_abs_deriv_inner_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (W : ℝ → Rn ℓ) (a : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0) (u : Rn ℓ), LipschitzOnWith K W (Icc (-a) a) → ‖u‖ ≤ 1 → ∀ᵐ r ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), r ∈ Ioo (-a) a → |deriv (fun x => inner ℝ u (W x)) r| ≤ ‖deriv W r‖
